title: Elon Musk wants to put data centers in space — here's what that could actually look like
title_zh: 埃隆·马斯克希望将数据中心置于太空中——这实际上可能是这样的
summary: SpaceX founder Elon Musk has said that he wants to put data centers in space for efficiency. One expert told Yahoo Finance how it would actually work.
summary_zh: SpaceX 创始人埃隆·马斯克表示，他希望将数据中心置于太空中以提高效率。一位专家告诉雅虎财经，它实际上是如何运作的。

title: 'There's mania': Strategists weigh in on looming SpaceX IPO
title_zh: “市场狂热”：策略师对即将到来的 SpaceX IPO 发表看法
summary: It may be best for investors to wait until some of the excitement surrounding SpaceX fades before jumping in.
summary_zh: 对于投资者来说，最好等到围绕 SpaceX 的兴奋情绪消退后再入手。

title: Scenes from the Memorial Day investing road: Takeaways on Walmart, Nvidia, and GameStop
title_zh: 阵亡将士纪念日投资之路场景：沃尔玛、英伟达和 GameStop 的要点
summary: A big week for investors, let's not overlook it.
summary_zh: 对于投资者来说这是重要的一周，我们不要忽视。

title: Stocks and earnings surge, and Iran deal may be imminent: What to watch this week
title_zh: 股市和盈利飙升，伊朗协议可能迫在眉睫：本周看点
summary: With earnings season done, the stock market moves into digestion and distraction territory as investors integrate the whole of corporate data with extracurricular corporate news, economic releases, the bond market's not-so-subtle signals, and whatever distractions, surprises, ...
summary_zh: 随着财报季结束，股市进入消化和分散注意力的领域，因为投资者将整个公司数据与课外公司新闻、经济发布、债券市场不那么微妙的信号以及任何分散注意力的事情、意外事件等结合起来……

title: Trump traded over $50 million in 'Magnificent 7' stocks last quarter, loading up on Apple and Google and selling Tesla
title_zh: 特朗普上个季度交易了超过 5000 万美元的“Magnificent 7”股票，买入苹果和谷歌并出售特斯拉
summary: President Trump made 94 different trades of 'Magnificent 7' stocks in the first quarter of 2026, a new ethics disclosure shows, executing millions of dollars in transactions even as he was meeting with and often promoting these top tech companies.
summary_zh: 一份新的道德披露显示，特朗普总统在 2026 年第一季度对“Magnificent 7”股票进行了 94 笔不同的交易，即使在他与这些顶级科技公司会面并经常推销这些公司的同时，也执行了数百万美元的交易。
